correctness.rationale: For each unselected rung and each unselected upper/lower horizontal edge, exact incidence counting gives three Boolean constraints; these are necessary and sufficient for PED. Exhausting all 64 ordered consecutive masks and both boundary conditions leaves 14 relevant states: one looping all-edges component and a six-cycle with two exits. Structural walk classification gives exactly one full-edge set and 2 or 4 proper sets of size n, all n>=2, so proof is infinite not extrapolation. Independently brute-tested 599184 subsets for n=2..7 and symbolic finite-transition polynomials for n=2..160, with hardcoded independent transition certificate.

value.rationale: A complete solution classification with a surprising two-point support and sharp period-three multiplicity for a canonical infinite Cartesian-product family is intrinsically meaningful, beyond an algorithm or minimum objective. It distinguishes perfect edge domination from efficient edge domination and supplies a portable structural transition certificate. The result is not a low-order arbitrary example, parameter renaming or tiny numerical optimization.
